restriction: Permitted as a preservative in cosmetic products only within the stated limits.

opinion: The SCCS considers Propylparaben safe for use as a preservative in cosmetic products at concentrations up to 0.14%. Although available data indicate potential endocrine effects, the evidence is insufficient to classify Propylparaben as an endocrine-disrupting substance or to establish a risk assessment threshold based on such effects. Environmental safety was not assessed.
